texturebrush.configuration.title: Texture Brush
texturebrush.configuration.pattern.toolt:
Random: weighted random every placement.
Noise: weighted patches, so blocks form clumps.
Cycle: evenly interleaved order that follows the weights.
Checker: alternates by position, ignoring weights.
texturebrush.configuration.noiseScale.to: Rough size, in blocks, of the patches made by the Noise pattern.
texturebrush.configuration.noiseSeed.too: Change this to get a different arrangement of Noise patches.
texturebrush.configuration.defaultWeight: Weight for hotbar blocks that have no entry in Hotbar Weights.
texturebrush.configuration.weights.toolt:
Hotbar mode ratios, one per line as item=weight.
Example: minecraft:bricks=3 and minecraft:granite=1 gives 75% bricks, 25% granite.
A weight of 0 leaves that block out.
texturebrush.configuration.palettes.tool:
Named palettes, one per line as Name: item=weight, item=weight, ...
Cycle through them in game with N.
texturebrush.configuration.activePalette: Name of the palette in use. Leave empty to use the blocks in your hotbar.
texturebrush.configuration.showHud.toolt: Show the brush status above the hotbar and mark palette slots while the brush is on.
